title: Bijectivity of normalized affine degree comparison homomorphisms
statement: For affine étale objects U and W, quasi-coherent F and degree n, every homomorphism satisfying the pure-tensor normalization is bijective on the underlying additive groups.

proof.text: Use the affine pullback sections formula and affine fibre-product tensor description to identify the normalized map on additive tensor generators with the canonical comparison; tensor induction gives equality on all elements, and the canonical comparison is bijective.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03P2, affine-case identification, expanded using Tags 01I9 and 01IA

theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom_bijective
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    Function.Bijective (AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom f)
